name:
Channelhack
& the New Scene
description: A one-day distributed event across San Francisco and New York where artists, roboticists, live coders and builders share one temporary institution: demo stations, salons, performances, screenings and a live portal between the two floors.

style.art_direction: Dense illustrated event concept art, wide shot, thick ink lines, halftone shading, neon accents over a dark industrial venue, lots of screens, cables, robots and people mid-action
style.avoid: text, logos, watermarks, photorealism, empty rooms
